You are a fork building ONE part of the Sounding frontend. Write only these files: /root/fathom-clone/src/pages/Meeting.jsx (replace the stub) and /root/fathom-clone/src/pages/meeting.css (import it at the top of Meeting.jsx). Do not edit any other file. Do not deploy, restart services, or touch the GPU box.

Export `MeetingPage({ id, query })`. Use helpers from ../api.js (get/post/patch/del/useApi/mediaUrl/clipUrl/downloadUrl/STAGES/busy/qs) and ../ui.jsx (Modal, Menu, Tabs, Field, Spinner, Loading, ErrorNote, Empty, Avatar, fmtClock, fmtDate, fmtAgo, speakerHue, copyText, absLink, go, setQuery, useApp, useAction, VIS_LABEL). The API is exactly the backend in /root/fathom-clone/server/sounding/routes (read meetings.py, collab.py, org.py for shapes). useApp() gives { me, org, teams, isAdmin, members, toast }.

Must implement (Fathom-style meeting page):
1. Processing state: while stage is busy, poll GET /meetings/{id} every 2.5s and show the stage steps (queued shows "N ahead in line" from m.queue); failed shows error + delete button (if can_edit).
2. Header: back link, title (inline editable for can_edit), date, duration, owner, meeting-type select (editors; PATCH meeting_type_id), companies tags, visibility summary. Actions: Share (modal: visibility private/team/org + team select for editors; add people from members list via POST /meetings/{id}/shares, remove via DELETE; create link public or org-only via POST /meetings/{id}/links, list/copy (absLink('#/s/'+token)) / revoke DELETE /links/{token}); "Add to folder" (modal listing GET /folders, POST /folders/{fid}/items, plus quick-create folder); Download menu (mp3, mp4 when has_video, transcript txt/srt/vtt, notes md — plain <a href download>); "Draft follow-up email" (modal: POST /meetings/{id}/followup, editable subject/body, Copy button); Delete (editors, confirm).
3. Player: <video> when has_video (mediaUrl(id,'video')) else hidden <audio> with custom controls: play/pause, time, skip back/forward 15s, speed 1/1.25/1.5/2. A talk-time strip (clickable/keyboard slider) colored per speaker using speakerHue(m.speakers, label), with small markers for highlights and comments. Legend with talk % per speaker from m.metrics.per_speaker; editors can rename a speaker (names) and link a speaker to a teammate (speaker_users) via a small popover. A "Highlight" button creates a clip from ~20s before to ~10s after the current time (POST /meetings/{id}/highlights) then lets the user edit its title.
4. Transcript: find box, auto-follow active line (pause following when user scrolls), speaker names from m.names, click timestamp to seek. Per-line menu: "Clip from here" (start a range; next click on another line's "End clip here" finishes it), "Comment at this moment", and for editors "Trim this part", "Trim everything before", "Trim everything after" (confirm; POST /meetings/{id}/trim; then reload).
5. Right panel tabs (remember via setQuery({tab})): Summary (template select from GET /templates → POST resummarize, show a spinner while m.pending includes 'resummarize' and poll; translate select using languages Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Dutch, Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese → POST translate and render translated; "Copy notes" with a with/without timestamps choice; sections with bullets, each bullet's timestamp is a clickable seek). Action items (checkbox toggles via PATCH actions [{id,done}] for any viewer; editors: assignee select from members, edit text, add a new item {new:true,text}; jump to t). Ask (single-meeting chat via POST /meetings/{id}/ask; parse [m:ss] or [h:mm:ss] into seek buttons; suggestion chips). Clips (list highlights; play in page by seeking and stopping at end; edit title/note; copy share link (POST links with highlight_id, org or public); add to playlist (GET /playlists, POST items, quick-create); delete). Comments (list with timestamp chips; add comment with optional "at current time" toggle; @mention autocomplete from members that sends mentions:[ids]; delete own). Insights (per-speaker talk metrics table; tracker hits from m.tracker_hits with seek; scorecards from m.scorecards with criteria scores/reasons/seek and a Re-score button for editors).
6. Honor query.t (seek there once loaded) and query.tab.
7. Responsive: on <900px stack panels; no horizontal overflow at 390px. Keyboard focus visible, aria labels on icon buttons, respects prefers-reduced-motion.

Style: follow the existing design system in /root/fathom-clone/src/styles.css (CSS variables, .primary/.secondary/.link/.pill/.tag/.transcript/.line/.stamp classes). Prefix new classes with `mt-`. Writing: sentence case, plain verbs, buttons say what they do, errors explain how to fix; no all-caps labels, no emoji. Keep code readable and consistent with App.jsx/rows.jsx style.

Verify with: cd /root/fathom-clone && npx vite build --outDir /tmp/claude-0/-root/a2db516c-9100-4760-bff1-2f9fe28ddb93/scratchpad/build-meeting (must succeed; other pages may still be stubs). Then report: what you implemented, anything you skipped, and any backend gaps you noticed (don't fix backend yourself).

I built the meeting page in `src/pages/Meeting.jsx` and `src/pages/meeting.css`. `vite build` succeeds, but nothing was checked in a browser or against the live API. Nothing is committed and nothing else was touched.

**What's in it**
- **Processing view:** polls every 2.5 s while the meeting is processing, shows the stage steps, and shows "N ahead in line" when queued. A failed meeting shows the error and, for editors, a delete button.
- **Header:**
  - Back link. Title renames inline for editors. Date, length and owner.
  - Meeting-type select for editors; others see a tag. Company tags link to the company page. A visibility chip opens the Share dialog.
  - Buttons: Share, Draft follow-up email, a Download menu (mp3, mp4 when there's video, txt, srt, vtt, md), and a More menu with Add to folder and Delete for editors.
- **Player:**
  - Video when there is one, otherwise hidden audio with custom controls: play/pause, back and forward 15 s, time, speed 1–2x.
  - A Highlight button saves 20 s before to 10 s after the current time as a clip, then opens it for editing.
  - The speaker strip works by click and by keyboard (arrows, space). Markers show clips and comments.
  - Legend with talk %. Editors get a popover to rename a speaker and link them to a teammate.
- **Transcript:**
  - Find box with match count and highlighting. Follows playback, pauses following when you scroll, with a "Follow playback" button to resume.
  - Each line has a menu: Clip from here / End clip here (with a banner and Cancel), Comment at this moment, and for editors three trim options. Trim asks for confirmation, then reloads clips and comments.
- **Right-hand tabs** (remembered in the URL, `?t=` seeks on load):
  - **Summary:** template picker triggers a rewrite and shows a spinner until it's done. Language picker translates. Copy notes with or without timestamps. Every point's timestamp seeks.
  - **Action items:** anyone can tick. Editors can reassign, edit text and add items. Jump to the moment.
  - **Ask:** suggestion chips; `[m:ss]` and `[h:mm:ss]` in answers become seek buttons.
  - **Clips:** plays in page and stops at the clip's end. Copy org or public link, add to playlist (with quick create), edit title and note, delete for the clip's creator or an editor.
  - **Comments:** optional timestamp (pre-filled from a transcript line), @mention autocomplete that sends mention ids, delete your own.
  - **Insights:** talk-time table, tracker hits grouped by tracker, scorecards with feedback, per-criterion scores and reasons, and a Score again button for editors.
- **Dialogs:**
  - **Share:** visibility and team for editors (admins see all teams), add and remove people, create, copy and turn off org or public links. Non-editors see an explanation instead.
  - **Add to folder:** with quick create.
  - **Follow-up email:** editable subject and body, write another draft, open in email app (mailto to attendees), copy.
- **Other:** at under 900 px the panels stack and the line menus stay visible. Icon buttons have aria labels, focus is visible, and smooth scrolling is off with reduced motion.

**Skipped:** no keyboard shortcuts beyond the speaker strip, and the Ask conversation isn't kept when you leave the page.

**Backend gaps I noticed (not fixed):**
- A single PATCH can't both link a speaker to a teammate and give them a different name: the teammate's name always wins, so the UI sends two PATCHes.
- `GET /meetings/{id}/links` only lists links you created, so editors can't see or turn off links made by other editors.
- Editing a clip's title or note requires sending `start` and `end` too, because the endpoint reuses the create model.
- `POST /meetings/{id}/translate` runs synchronously in the request (about 20 s), with no job or cache warming.
